page.overview:
Who is Slattery?

Admiral Slattery was a Starfleet flag officer who served in the 24th century.

At the Command Conference afterparty in 2378, Slattery became so intoxicated that he commandeered a light cruiser and flew "halfway to the Delta Quadrant" before he sobered up. ()
